title: meetingIdentity collapses every Meet URL whose first path segment is not a meeting code (lookup/<id>, landing, new, root) into one key, so a live lookup-link meeting wrongly refuses a different meeting
evidence: packages/meeting-bot/src/send-now.ts:91-94 takes path.split('/').filter(Boolean)[0] as the Meet code with no shape check. meetingIdentity('https://meet.google.com/lookup/abcdef') and ('https://meet.google.com/lookup/abcdeg') both return 'meet:lookup'; '/landing' -> 'meet:landing'; the bare root accepted as ok plan with key 'meet:meet.google.com'. Calendar-generated Meet links use /lookup/<id>, so a second, different lookup-link meeting is refused duplicate-live-job while the first is queued/joining/recording. Also /new, /landing and the bare root are accepted as ok plans although they are not a meeting.
reproduction: planSendNow('https://meet.google.com/lookup/abcdeg', new Date('2026-10-10T10:00:00Z'), [{meetingUrl:'https://meet.google.com/lookup/abcdef', status:'recording'}]) -> {ok:false, reason:'duplicate-live-job', detail:'meet:lookup'}. planSendNow('https://meet.google.com/new', now) and planSendNow('https://meet.google.com/', now) -> ok:true.
fix_direction: Accept Meet only as /<xxx-xxxx-xxx> (3-4-3 letters, case-insensitive) -> key meet:<code>, and /lookup/<id> -> key meet:lookup:<id>; refuse other first segments (and the bare root) as unsupported-host/unsupported-path. Regression: the two lookup URLs above must give distinct keys; /new, /landing and root must be refused.
verified_evidence: cycle 2 checker replay of the recorded reproductions verbatim: 8/8 (lookup abcdef vs abcdeg distinct keys and not wrongly refused; /new, /, /landing, zoom root, zoom /foo refused not-a-meeting-url); all-platform probe found no non-meeting accept. See qa/verdicts/t039-send-bot-now-planner.md cycle 2.

title: Teams/Webex/Zoho dedupe keys on raw path+query, so trivially different spellings of one live meeting get a second bot (Teams p= passcode and context= JSON order not normalised)
evidence: send-now.ts:100-102: non-Meet/Zoom platforms key on host+path+sorted query minus TRACKING_KEY; 'p' (Teams meet passcode) and 'context' are not in the drop list and context is a raw JSON string compared as-is. Same meeting, different spellings, different keys: teams.live.com/meet/9876543210?p=abc vs ...meet/9876543210 ; teams.microsoft.com/l/meetup-join/19%3ameeting_AbC%40thread.v2/0?context={Tid,Oid} vs ?context={Oid,Tid} vs no context; teams.microsoft.com vs teams.live.com hosts. The manifest discloses the limitation but the unit's own stated purpose is refusing a duplicate live meeting.
reproduction: planSendNow('https://teams.live.com/meet/9876543210', now, [{meetingUrl:'https://teams.live.com/meet/9876543210?p=abc', status:'recording'}]).ok === true (second bot admitted). Same for the two meetup-join spellings with context JSON key order swapped.
fix_direction: For Teams key on the thread id (/l/meetup-join/<thread>/...) or the /meet/<numeric id>, ignoring p, context and host; for Webex key on host+meeting path/MTID case-insensitively. Regression: the pairs above must give one key.
verified_evidence: cycle 2 checker replay of the recorded reproductions verbatim: 7/7 (Teams /meet with and without p, meetup-join context A/B/absent, live.com vs microsoft host, raw-JSON order all one key or refused as duplicate). See qa/verdicts/t039-send-bot-now-planner.md cycle 2.

title: cloudonair still plans from the bare URL path: any non-empty path on cloudonair.withgoogle.com (e.g. /landing, /events) is an ok plan, the same class as cycle-0 non-meeting pages
evidence: send-now.ts meetingIdentity default branch: `id = path ? path : undefined` for platform cloudonair, so the only 'identifier' is whatever path is present. Cycle-1 probe: planSendNow('https://cloudonair.withgoogle.com/landing', now) -> ok:true, meetingKey 'cloudonair:/landing'; '/events' -> 'cloudonair:/events'; '/events/foo/bar' -> 'cloudonair:/events/foo/bar'. Only '/' is refused (test asserts just that). The only real shape in repo fixtures/tests is /events/<slug>. Every other platform now requires a parsed identifier, so this is the one remaining path fallback and contradicts the cycle-1 claim that a recognised host with no identifier is refused as not-a-meeting-url.
fix_direction: Accept cloudonair only as /events/<slug> (single segment after /events/, case-insensitive) -> key cloudonair:/events/<slug>; refuse everything else as not-a-meeting-url. Regression: /landing, /events, /events/ must be refused; /events/foo and /events/Foo/?utm_x=1 share one key.
verified_evidence: cycle 2 checker replay: 8/8 (/landing, /events, /events/, /events/foo/bar refused not-a-meeting-url; /events/foo, /events/Foo/?utm_x=1, host-case and fragment variants share key cloudonair:/events/foo; duplicate refused; different slug admitted). See qa/verdicts/t039-send-bot-now-planner.md cycle 2.
